headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Lal PathLabs delivered a strong Q2 FY27 performance, with consolidated revenue increasing 19.6% YoY to INR 874 Cr, supported by healthy diagnostic volumes.
EBITDA grew 25.1% YoY to INR 280 Cr, with EBITDA margin improving to 32.1% from 30.6% in Q2 FY26, reflecting operating leverage and improved business mix.
Patient volumes grew 9.0% YoY to 9.0 million, while sample volumes increased 13.6% to 28.8 million.
The company continued to witness healthy organic growth, supported by preventive healthcare adoption, improving test mix and increasing demand for specialized diagnostics.
valuation: Valuation call: At the CMP of INR 1,963, DLPL is trading at approximately 36x FY29E P/E.
We revise our rating from BUY to SELL, with a revised price target of INR 1,691 implying an Downside of 14%.
watch: Network expansion remains a key priority, with the company operating 312 clinical laboratories, 7,727 patient service centres and 13,935 pick-up points as of FY26.

Management highlighted broad-based growth across all geographies. • Positive FY27 growth outlook: Management indicated that H1 FY27 performance is ahead of internal expectations and expects revenue growth to remain in the high-teens range for FY27.
